name: Hasp
description: A hasp: a slotted plate dropped over a staple.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 6%; top: 30%; width: 62%; height: 40%; border-radius: 999px 0 0 999px; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0% 0%, 100% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%, 0% 0%, 30.0% 34.0%, 30.0% 66.0%, 70.0% 66.0%, 70.0% 34.0%, 30.0% 34.0%); clip-path: polygon(0% 0%, 100% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%, 0% 0%, 30.0% 34.0%, 30.0% 66.0%, 70.0% 66.0%, 70.0% 34.0%, 30.0% 34.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 58%; top: 22%; width: 36%; height: 56%; border-radius: 0 999px 999px 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 54%, #000 54%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 54%, #000 54%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
